intro: Our Nova mattress helps you wake up feeling re-energised. Memory foam gently hugs your body, while natural coir keeps airflow steady—so you stay cool, supported, and ready for the day.

features.title: Foam that adapts to you all night
features.text: Reclaim restful nights—pressure-relieving foam technology melts away tension, so you wake up energised and ready for the day.

features.title: Natural coir keeps your sleep fresh and cool
features.text: Sleep cooler and cleaner! Eco-friendly breathable coir improves airflow and keeps your mattress fresh, so you wake up feeling revitalised.

features.title: Firm foam keeps you steady and supported
features.text: Our robust foam base keeps your spine aligned and prevents sagging, so your back stays supported night after night with the comfort you deserve.

features.title: Quilted surface for cozy comfort
features.text: Every night feels indulgent with our soft quilted top, wrapping you in hotel-style comfort with breathable fabric designed for lasting freshness.

features.title: Custom sizing ensures a perfect fit
features.text: Our customisable dimensions make it easy to achieve a perfect fit for beds of all shapes and sizes.
